items.summaryEn:
Every week, women turn up to No Girls Walk Alone in Austin and leave with new friends, connecting over shared interests. 
Last night, we got to be part of it. They brought the community and we opened the doors to our world. 
Thank you for letting us be a part of it. #USGP
detailZh:

昨晚，我们得以成为其中一部分。她们带来了社区，而我们则打开了我们世界的大门。

感谢你们让我们成为其中的一部分。#USGP
detailEn:
